content.text: {"notes":["The requested readout time is absolute simulation time t=1.0 s from the initialized state.","Joint angles and angular velocities are in each joint’s local frame, use unwrapped right-hand angles, and are reported in rad and rad/s; tip position is a world-frame vector in meters.","The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; all channels use SI units.","A scheduled +0.5 N·m torque intervention acts on joint_1 over [0.4229, 0.5229) s; joint_limit_by_T indicates whether either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by the requested time."]}
